name: wordpress
notes: UNVERIFIED in this build environment: there is no network here to pull the image or stand the app up, so port/health/behavior below are from documented WordPress defaults, not observed in-place. Canonical image: `wordpress:latest` from Docker Official Images (https://hub.docker.com/_/wordpress). REQUIRES A DATABASE: WordPress needs a MySQL/MariaDB backend the operator must wire as a companion container (e.g. `mariadb:11` or `mysql:8` reachable at WORDPRESS_DB_HOST=db:3306) with matching WORDPRESS_DB_USER/PASSWORD/NAME env; the single app image alone will not become healthy without it. INSTALL STEP: on first boot the app is uninstalled — the root `/` returns a 302 redirect to `/wp-admin/install.php` (the install wizard), which is why health accepts 200/301/302; to exercise authenticated/admin surface the operator must complete the 5-minute install wizard (set site title, admin user/password) and then log in at `/wp-login.php`. Give it a generous startup window (health_timeout_s=120) because the container waits on the DB to be ready. GROUND TRUTH: kind=none — this is real, unmodified production CMS software with no planted bugs, so we are NOT measuring recall; we are measuring false-positive count, crawl/discovery behavior, and performance against a realistic app. This target is chosen for fingerprinting, version/exposure detection (e.g. /wp-json, /readme.html, /wp-login.php, /xmlrpc.php, meta generator tag), and passive coverage — hence use_library=true. Any confirmed "vulnerability" the scanner reports against a clean stock install should be treated as a candidate false positive unless the operator has intentionally installed a vulnerable plugin/theme (not done here). drop_timing=true since no timing-based checks are needed for FP/discovery measurement. REVIEW (honesty/plausibility): verified canonical image, container_port=80 + health_path=/ with 200/301/302 all correct for the stock image's install-redirect behavior; ground_truth.kind=none so no curated-location/bug_class vocabulary check applies; notes honestly disclose unverified-in-build-env, DB + install-wizard/auth needs, and the FP/curation caveat; heavy=false is correct (WordPress is not in the heavy set of owasp-benchmark/gitlab-ce/mattermost). No corrections required.
